notes.title: Monitor, Video Mode, and Rumble Update
notes.content:
Bringing back the rumble, and also providing a means to change monitor and video mode in options.

It is probably best just to leave the video mode and monitor, but for users who need to change this, it is now possible.

We also changed the way we do force feedback... some controllers are not supported, but hopefully it won't crash now even if enabled. We still do not know which controllers were causing the problem, so if you did have this issue, let us know. If you have any odd controller issues, please tell us, and we'll acquire the same model controller to test.

[list]
[*] Added title to scanner map in modern
[*] Added Monitor and Video Mode selection
[*] Added "-safemode" startup option to revert video and monitor settings to default
[*] Fixed bug in highest level completed data saved
[*] Added an option to enable and disable Force Feedback
[*] Changed the way force feedback is set, using Unity's new Input System to handle it now
[/list]

notes.title: Mitigation update
notes.content:
Crashes may be the result of issues with our native input module (for gamepad force feedback), so we are disabling the module for the time being. It will return as a configurable item in the near future.

[list]
[*] Disabled native input module
[*] Made intro slightly less annoying
[*] Mitigation changes to resource loading
[/list]
